queue.question: Which current UE 5.8, SideFX Karma, and modern atmosphere/whole-atmosphere ideas are transferable into KAOPU as vendor-independent atmosphere/lighting semantics and evaluator contracts without copying engine implementations or defaults?
queue.progress: R01-R06 established state/evaluator separation, ground-to-space semantics, query-scoped evaluator validity, multi-root Earth references, evidence dependency, per-quantity validity, typed Missing/Unsupported, and split-overlap semantics. R07 locked and distilled Takram three-geospatial reference-frame/evaluator architecture. R08 defined typed Weather vertical-coordinate semantics and rejected a universal cloud-altitude scalar. R09 exercised a bounded real radiosonde-derived Salt Lake City column fixture and found a more important operation boundary: coordinate conversion must preserve the same physical atmospheric state, while preserving AGL after moving a weather pattern to different terrain is a spatial retarget that needs DerivedSyntheticRetarget lineage. The R09 probe passed 7/7. Candidate runtime contracts now split RuntimeCloudPlacement, CloudOpticalClosure and EvaluatorBudget. The Weather-coupling gate is only partially closed because the exact fixture was transported through a UCAR mirror rather than byte-authenticated against NCEI in this bounded runtime, geoid-to-ellipsoid provenance remains open, and physically grounded cloud optical closure is still missing. No production Mother branch was modified.
